channel.title: Your Engine changelog
channel.description: Every ship of Your Engine by OddsEngine, dated. $ODDS on Robinhood Chain: 0x9c87b4cfa21266d1638f437c96dbe1012cb81111

item.title: v2.80: What HEY read: builder records in every Robinhood Chain scan
item.description: Token scans and Project Research on Robinhood Chain now show what HEY Research Lab recorded about the team: verified builder or not, recent ships and status, with a link to the full record on HEY. It is shown as HEY's record, next to our own findings and never mixed with them.

item.title: v2.80: Scan fixes: first buyers and launcher contracts
item.description: Holdings of the first buyers are read straight from the token, so large coins no longer show 0% still holding by mistake. Coins made through a factory or launcher contract show both: the dev wallet and the launcher it used.

item.title: v2.80: Locker page: extra safety checks
item.description: The page only talks to the one ODDS Locker contract it was built for. If the server ever named another contract, every button locks and a warning shows. NFT positions (for example Uniswap V3 LP) are blocked before you approve anything: they could not be withdrawn again. Locking for another wallet needs a second confirmation, with a clear warning for contracts and exchange deposit addresses. Independent review of the contract: only the lock owner can withdraw, nothing unlocks early, and the admin can only change fees and the treasury.

item.title: v2.80: Database pool: deep scans fast again
item.description: The engine used one database connection for everything; under load up to 990 threads waited in one queue. Rebuilt with a connection pool, now 10 to 40 threads. Deep scans that could not start are no longer stuck as running for 10 minutes.

item.title: v2.80: x402: pay per scan with USDC on Base or Solana
item.description: Any AI agent can buy a full token scan per call, no key and no signup: GET api.oddsengine.live/v1/x402/scan, $0.02. Pays with USDC on Base, USDC on Solana (fees paid by the facilitator) or $ODDS on Robinhood Chain. Discovery data in every 402 answer and a list of paid endpoints at /v1/x402/resources. Live tested: our own agent paid on Base, tx 0x27da4e08cf97053220c556a3a261c5994d4b31c6272db4647e75eac6a5634c68. Live tested on Solana: our agent paid in USDC, tx KzMUrsFzRvm9MVW8FQLcGue8jPHxDSqv142G7iQbFEZZv58QHVfMqsC1u3yp3CuymVKHuHwxuxL5m9JadxzcDBg.

item.title: v2.78: Funder network in the deep scan
item.description: Who funded the dev, what that wallet did with the coin, which other wallets it funded, whether they launched coins through the same launch contract, ETH sent back, admin wallets with the same funder. With proof links. Launch block buys counted by amount bought, not by what is held now: a 10% snipe sold within seconds no longer passes as no bundle. The money trail always follows the first funding payment, also small gas money.

item.title: v2.78: Dev check, Wallet Guard and voice
item.description: Dev check reads where the dev's tokens came from: own allocation, bought or received, and retries when the RPC is busy. Wallet Guard: an approval given inside your own buy is a quiet note, not an alarm. Approvals outside your own trades still alert. Voice recognition knows the coins that were scanned recently.

item.title: v2.77: Scan fixes on Robinhood Chain
item.description: Liquidity held by a launchpad (Torch, Pons) is shown as such instead of 0% locked. Locks are shown even when small. LP pools ranked by liquidity. Copycat warnings only for the same chain. Smart wallets counted only with a strong record.

item.title: v2.77: Portfolio card
item.description: Portfolio across all your wallets as one card: total, by coin with PnL against your buy, by wallet. Holdings without a price are named instead of silently left out.

item.title: v2.74: Radar track record
item.description: Every coin the GTA radar finds is followed for 3 days (1 h, 6 h, 24 h, 72 h, peak) and marked runner, dead or flat.

item.title: v2.73: Portfolio manager
item.description: Add your own wallets in the chat and track them across chains.

item.title: v2.72: Robinhood stock tokens, 24/7
item.description: Prices around the clock, daily movers, comparison with the exchange price and alerts in percent.
